signup.title: Create your account
signup.displayNameHint: How your travel companions will see you
signup.closedBody: You need an invitation from a trip owner to join.
signup.invitedEmail: Use the e-mail address the invitation was sent to.

invite.title: You are invited
invite.notFoundBody: Check the link you received; it may have been copied incompletely.
invite.expiredTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
invite.expiredBody: Ask the trip owner for a new one.

verify.title: Verify your e-mail
verify.body: We sent a link and a 6-digit code to {{email}}.
verify.codeHint: The six digits from the e-mail
verify.resendIn: Send a new code in {{seconds}} s
verify.sent: A new code is on its way.
verify.verifiedBody: You can now use every part of the app.
verify.linkExpiredTitle: This link is no longer valid
verify.linkExpiredBody: Links work once and for 15 minutes. Sign in and request a new code.
verify.signInFirst: Sign in to verify with the code.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.body: Tell us your e-mail and we will send a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a link is on its way. It works once, for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Every session was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
reset.expiredTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once, for 60 minutes.
reset.missingToken: Open this page from the link in the e-mail.

errors.E_INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That e-mail and password do not match.
errors.E_TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
errors.E_REGISTRATION_CLOSED: Registration is closed; you need an invitation.
errors.E_EMAIL_TAKEN: There is already an account with this e-mail.
errors.E_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link or code is no longer valid.
errors.E_INVITATION_EXPIRED: This invitation is no longer valid.
errors.E_INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different e-mail address.
errors.E_BAD_CSRF_TOKEN: This page is out of date. Reload and try again.
errors.E_UNAUTHORIZED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
